jazmin.translation:
贾斯明
贾丝明（人名）

jazmine.translation: [人名] 贾斯明，贾丝明（女名）

jazmyn.translation: [人名] 贾斯明，贾丝明（女名）

jazz.definition:
n. a genre of popular music that originated in New Orleans around 1900 and developed through increasingly complex styles
n. a style of dance music popular in the 1920s; similar to New Orleans jazz but played by large bands
v. play something in the style of jazz
jazz.translation:
n. 爵士乐, 喧闹
a. 爵士乐的, 喧吵的
vi. 演奏爵士乐, 跳爵士舞, 游荡
vt. 奏爵士乐, 使活泼

jazz festival.translation: [网络] 爵士音乐节；节庆有爵士音乐节；爵士乐节

jazz musician.translation: [网络] 爵士乐手；爵士音乐家；爵士音乐乐师

jazzed.definition:
v play something in the style of jazz
v have sexual intercourse with
jazzed.translation: vt. 把…奏成爵士音乐（jazz的过去式与过去分词形式）

jazzed-up.translation: adj. 丰富多彩的，品种繁多的，新颖的

jazzers.translation: (jazzer 的复数)  爵士乐爱好者

s. (used especially of clothes) marked by conspicuous display
jazzier.translation: a. 活泼的( jazzy的比较级 ); 兴奋的; 鲜艳的; 花哨的
